title: COVID NTC Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and labware
steps.instruction: Gather nuclease‑free water, multiple 2 mL tubes, a P300 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, and Opentrons aluminum blocks.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons software, input the required parameters for the water transfer (e.g., number of tubes, volume per tube).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file from the Opentrons interface.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the aluminum blocks and 2 mL tubes on the deck as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip rack, the P300 pipette, and the labware (tubes, blocks) following the calibration workflow.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated transfer of nuclease‑free water into the 2 mL tubes.
